title: Validate skillOverrides in editable settings
objective: Allow safe editing of four-state skill overrides while rejecting malformed keys, values, and managed-policy bypass attempts.
context: Implement the accepted hybrid skill catalog design in the dirty shared worktree.
Registry state is authoritative; prompt messages are an append-only model projection and never the authorization boundary.

source_evidence.note: Bounded metadata catalog and on-demand full skill content.
Live discovery and four-state skill visibility controls.
Append-only messages preserve the prior cached prefix.

include: Add skillOverrides to the settings schema/allowlist.

Require stable SkillID keys and validate either the backward-compatible local four-state scalar shape or the structured visibility plus optional last_non_off record; name and qualified selectors are resolved by command/UI layers before persistence.
Require last_non_off, when present, to be auto, name-only, or manual-only and reject it for malformed/non-off records.
Reject unknown states and attempts to write managed-only fields.
exclude: Do not modify files owned by another task.
Do not add dependencies or perform unrelated refactors.

implementation_steps: Add valid, invalid, nested, unknown-field, and backward-compatibility tests.
acceptance_criteria: Valid overrides pass existing settings edit flows.
Persistent keys are stable SkillIDs only; ambiguous names and qualified selectors never become settings identities.
Legacy scalar overrides and structured off-plus-last_non_off overrides both validate without weakening unknown-field checks.
Invalid visibility values fail before writing.
Existing settings keys keep their behavior.
dispatch_prompt: Extend the existing settings validator for skillOverrides and add focused tests. Do not implement storage or /skills behavior.
notes_for_assignee: Respect owned_files. Escalate contract gaps to the integration owner rather than editing another task's production files.
